reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 6 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hawks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hawks.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 68 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 202 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: Lu Dort and Aaron Wiggins return to Oklahoma City for the first time since being traded for second-round picks; Dort called it 'a lot of memories', while Wiggins says 'this is who I represent now'. Atlanta are banged up, with CJ McCollum out about four weeks (calf). The angle leans towards the Thunder, with some extra fire from the returning Hawks.
